content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides for 1 (One) vacancy for the post of Skill Lab Coordinator on a contractual basis for a duration of 12 months (extended based on performance).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualifications and experience requirements specified for the SHSRC Skill Lab Coordinator position.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Public Health, Nursing, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or a related field. Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in healthcare training, skill development, clinical education, simulation-based training, or health programme management. Certification/training in simulation-based education, Skill Lab management, competency-based training, or instructional design. Experience of working with health programmes or health departments. Experience in managing healthcare training centres, simulation laboratories, or nursing/medical education facilities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly remuneration of INR 50,000 . The nature of work is contractual for a duration of 12 months (extended based on performance).

content_sections.heading: SHSRC Skill Lab Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The Skill Lab Coordinator will be responsible for the overall coordination, operational management, training support, and monitoring of activities conducted through the Skill Lab. The key responsibilities include: Develop and maintain a monthly Skill Lab training calendar in consultation with the Regional Health & Family Welfare Training Centre (RHFWTC). Coordinate training programmes, workshops, demonstrations, simulation sessions, and competency assessments. Coordinate with trainers, faculty, clinical experts, and participating institutions for effective delivery of training. Ensure that training schedules are aligned with identified capacity-building needs and departmental priorities. Facilitate scheduling and allocation of Skill Lab facilities, equipment, and training resources. Oversee the day-to-day functioning and effective utilization of the Skill Lab. Ensure that all simulation equipment, mannequins, instruments, audiovisual facilities, and other training materials are available and functional. Maintain an inventory of equipment, consumables, training materials, and other resources. Coordinate preventive maintenance, servicing, calibration, and repair of Skill Lab equipment. Ensure proper storage, handling, cleaning, and maintenance of equipment. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Skill Lab operations. Ensure adherence to safety, infection prevention and control, and other applicable standards. Coordinate the conduct of competency-based training for doctors, nurses, paramedics, and other healthcare professionals. Support trainers/facilitators in preparing training sessions, simulation scenarios, demonstrations, and practical exercises. Ensure availability of appropriate training materials and equipment before each training session. Assist in conducting pre-training and post-training assessments. Facilitate skills demonstrations, return demonstrations, simulation exercises, and competency assessments as required. Maintain records of participants trained and competencies assessed. Monitor the quality and effectiveness of training programmes conducted at the Skill Lab. Ensure that training sessions are conducted according to approved curricula, guidelines, and competency standards. Collect feedback from trainees and trainers and identify areas for improvement. Track training outcomes and competency achievement. Undertake periodic assessment of Skill Lab utilization and identify gaps in infrastructure, equipment, human resources, and training requirements. Support quality improvement initiatives based on monitoring findings. Maintain an updated database of all training activities, including number of training programmes conducted, number and category of participants trained, training topics/modules covered, competencies assessed, training outcomes, and trainer/facilitator details. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on Skill Lab activities. Maintain attendance registers, assessment records, feedback form

faq.question: Q1. What is the SHSRC Skill Lab Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the State Health Systems Resource Centre, Meghalaya for hiring a Skill Lab Coordinator on a contractual basis at the Centre for Health Innovation and Care Economy (CHICE), Umsawli, East Khasi Hills.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy available for the Skill Lab Coordinator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 26th October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Public Health, Nursing, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or a related field. Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in healthcare training, skill development, clinical education, simulation-based training, or health programme management. Certification/training in simulation-based education, Skill Lab management, competency-based training, or instructional design. Experience of working with health programmes or health departments. Experience in managing healthcare training centres, simulation laboratories, or nursing/medical education facilities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: Up to 45 years as on the last date for receiving applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary provided?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration of INR 50,000 will be provided.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention an application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: By filling in the application form by clicking on the link provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the second round of recruitment and personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this position permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The nature of work is contractual for a duration of 12 months (extended based on performance).
